title: Payments Schedule — Online Orders Capture Point, Authorization Validity and Tender Order
content:
Online Orders tenders are captured at dispatch, and the same payment settings apply to every delivery service.

| Delivery service | Tenders captured at | Card authorization valid for (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|
| Economy Ground | Dispatch | 7 |
| Pickup Point Delivery | Dispatch | 7 |
| Standard Ground | Dispatch | 7 |
| Expedited 2-Day | Dispatch | 7 |
| Next Business Day | Dispatch | 7 |
| Same-Day Courier | Dispatch | 7 |

A card authorization stays valid for 7 calendar days before it must be renewed.

## Order in which tenders are drawn at capture

Applies to Economy Ground, Pickup Point Delivery, Standard Ground, Expedited 2-Day, Next Business Day and Same-Day Courier alike:

1. Marlowe Rewards Note
2. Goodwill Credit
3. Bonus Gift Card
4. Return Store Credit
5. Gift card
6. Card or digital wallet

## Order in which order-level refunds go back to captured tenders

Applies to Economy Ground, Pickup Point Delivery, Standard Ground, Expedited 2-Day, Next Business Day and Same-Day Courier alike:

1. Card or digital wallet
2. Gift card
3. Return Store Credit
4. Bonus Gift Card
5. Goodwill Credit
6. Marlowe Rewards Note

## Reading the two lists

The refund order is the capture order reversed: the card or digital wallet, drawn last at capture, is the first tender an order-level refund goes back to, and the Marlowe Rewards Note, drawn first, is the last.
